name: stable-build
description: Community skills, an opt-in edit-time guard and docs MCP config for apps built on Arc, for Claude Code and Codex. Not affiliated with Circle.

plugins.name: stable-build
plugins.description: Builder journey for apps built on Arc: find an idea, scaffold a starter, catch Arc gotchas while editing, and check go-live readiness. Includes role skills for planning and review.

plugins.name: stable-build-mcp
plugins.description: Optional. Adds two remote HTTP MCP servers: Arc docs search (docs.arc.io/mcp) and Circle's codegen docs server (api.circle.com/v1/codegen/mcp). Both are anonymous and read-only.
